title: Two ways to work together.
intro: Depending on your profession and your professional framework, we offer two distinct modes of collaboration. They are never combined.

tracks.name: Peer referral
tracks.scope: For regulated professions where any commission is excluded - notaries, accountants, attorneys.
tracks.body: You recommend Proxy Papers to your clients in their direct interest, with no compensation and no financial agreement. We simply formalise the operational coordination between our teams and yours.
points: A privileged entry point for your files
Direct operational coordination with your firm
A Proxy Papers dedicated advisor for your clients

tracks.name: Business introduction
tracks.scope: For wealth managers, brokers, family offices, private banks and similar networks.
tracks.body: A formal business introduction agreement frames our collaboration and the related compensation.
points: Compensation defined on a transparent schedule
Joint design of a referral approach
A Proxy Papers dedicated advisor for your clients
